public interface InteractionId
eHealth interaction ID. Implementations of this interface should ensure that instances are singletons. The recommended way to achieve this is using enums.

  • Method Details

    • getTransactionConfiguration

      TransactionConfiguration getTransactionConfiguration()
      Returns the configuration of the transaction this interaction ID stands for, irrespective of the kind of transaction. Sub-interfaces provide a type-safe accessor of their own and override this method to delegate to it; this method exists for generic code that must not know which kind of transaction it is dealing with.
      Returns:
      the transaction configuration
      Since:
      6.0
